verdict.rationale: A guided first-run setup walkthrough is a fair question for a project-management SaaS like Basecamp, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes adding tools and inviting people (basecamp-docs-1) and reusable templates (basecamp-docs-15). Neither documents an interactive or guided onboarding flow, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time
